content.short: Fluid is a highly capital-efficient DeFi protocol by Instadapp optimizing lending and borrowing yields.
content.description: Fluid is an advanced decentralized finance protocol created by the Instadapp team to maximize capital efficiency across lending and borrowing markets. By utilizing an innovative architectural design, Fluid minimizes liquidity fragmentation and significantly improves the utilization rates of supplied assets compared to traditional models. Built for the Ethereum ecosystem, the protocol offers robust security mechanisms and smart contract interoperability for traders.
